story_type: stealth jet hovers and lands vertically on an amphibious assault ship at sea, sea trial
hook: This jet stops in midair and lands straight down on a ship.
narration: This fighter jet stops in midair, then lands straight down on a ship at sea.
It is the F-35B, tested aboard USS Wasp off North Carolina in 2013.
First, a short takeoff, launched off the deck by a crewman's signal.
To hover, its nozzle swings down while a lift fan blows air at the deck.
The pilot holds it still beside the ship, then slides sideways over the landing spot.
It was the second of three planned sea trials.
outcome: The jet landed on the Wasp.
title: F-35B hovers and lands on a ship
description:
Marine Corps and Lockheed Martin test pilots put the F-35B through vertical landings aboard USS Wasp off the coast of North Carolina on Aug. 19, 2013, the second of three planned sea trials.
